eas_text: A civil authority has issued A FIRE WARNING for the following counties or areas: Elmore, ID; at 4:17 PM on AUG 8, 2026 Effective until 4:17 PM AUG 9, 2026. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: There is a brush fire that jumped the road between Hill City & Old Hwy 68. Watch for fire, prepare supplies & evacuate if needed.
